item.title: Turkey Fund Assets Shrink by $54 Billion Amid Manipulation Probe
item.description: Turkey’s asset-management industry shrank by the equivalent of $54 billion in the two months through October as authorities investigated alleged market manipulation involving investment funds.

item.title: Barclays’ Rajadhayaksha Says Nvidia Market Angst Overdone
item.description: Barlcays' Global Research Chairman Ajay Rajadhyaksha says markets are overplaying jitters over a Nvidia leadership change and will back risk assets. "Things are not as bad as the markets suggest." He speaks to Bloomberg's Anna Edwards and Guy Johnson on Bloomberg's "The Opening Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: KKR Is Said to Emerge as Preferred Bidder for Japanese Curry Chain Ichibanya
item.description: US investment firm KKR & Co. has been selected as the preferred bidder for Japan’s largest curry rice chain Ichibanya Co., according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Deutsche Bank Processed Large Sums Linked to Epstein: FT
item.description: Internal documents showed that Deutsche Bank processed $582 million of suspicious payments linked to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, the Financial Times reported. Bloomberg's Guy Johnson explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
